instruction: I have train records on my desktop and need to create an alphabetically sorted list of all unique train IDs. Each line has: time, train_id, station_id, platform_no. Please generate this sorted list and add it at the end of the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting and sorting unique train IDs alphabetically. Verified with Python: 8 unique train IDs (E201, E205, E209, E213, E217, E221, E225, E229) from 100 records. Evaluator checks exact match of sorted list.
